svg.title: 证据驱动的推理与评测工程 · 证据辅助模型适配与争议推理协同
svg.desc: 附件分类与证据字段样本训练辅助模型，经量化回归后由 vLLM / Docker 部署为证据工具。DeepSeek Harness 通过 API 调用 deepseek-v4-pro 执行核心调查与定责，辅助服务返回带来源的结构化证据，写入共享案件状态并接受引用校验与回放评测。；案件样本与系统接入：Evidence Training Set，Reviewed Attachments / Field Labels，Source Spans / Holdout Cases；Case Task Adapter，Java / Spring，Task ID / Idempotency / Materials；deepseek-v4-pro API，HTTP / Timeout / Token Budget，Dispute Planning / Liability Reasoning；证据适配与自主调查：Evidence Model Fine-tuning，PyTorch / PEFT / LoRA / QLoRA，Document Classification / Extraction，Adapter / Field Accuracy Regression；DeepSeek Harness，Context Management / Tool Calling，Shared Facts / Investigation Steps；Skill Registry，Versioned Policy / Tool Contracts，Investigation Rules / Output Schema；量化产物与证据处理：Evidence Model Quantization，AWQ / GPTQ / Evidence Calibration，Quantized Weights / Tokenizer，Field Accuracy / Citation Coverage；Evidence Tool Runtime，Python / Docker / Tool Contracts，Attachment Classification / Fields，Source Span / Evidence ID；Shared Case State，PostgreSQL / Document Citation Index，Verified Facts / Pending Checks，Model / Skill / Material Version；推理服务与质量校验：Evidence Inference Service，vLLM / Docker / Quantized Model，Batch Inference / Concurrency Limit，Versioned Extraction Endpoint；Evidence Validation & Replay，JSON Schema / Citation Validation，Langfuse / Dataset Replay，Judgment / Tool Error / Cost；01 Evidence Training Set → Evidence Model Fine-tuning：附件类别、字段及原文位置监督样本；02 Evidence Model Fine-tuning → Evidence Model Quantization：适配权重与独立证据样本回归；03 Evidence Model Quantization → Evidence Inference Service：通过字段与引用检查的量化模型；04 Case Task Adapter → DeepSeek Harness：审核任务、材料引用与任务标识；05 Skill Registry → DeepSeek Harness：装载核查 Skill、工具契约与输出约束；06 DeepSeek Harness ↔ deepseek-v4-pro API：核心推理请求 / 调查步骤与责任判断；07 DeepSeek Harness ↔ Evidence Tool Runtime：受控工具调用 / 带来源的证据返回；08 Evidence Tool Runtime ↔ Evidence Inference Service：附件分类与字段抽取请求 / 结构化要素；09 DeepSeek Harness ↔ Shared Case State：共享事实读取 / 调查进展更新；10 Evidence Tool Runtime → Shared Case State：证据字段、原文位置与材料版本；11 Shared Case State → Evidence Validation & Replay：案件事实、证据引用及执行版本
